title: E0092: XML External Entity (XXE)
plain_english: Parsing XML from untrusted input without disabling external entity resolution can allow an attacker to read local files or make outbound requests from your server.
why_matters: - Local file disclosure (for example `/etc/passwd`, source code, or credentials) - Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) against internal services - Port scanning of internal networks - Denial of service
what_it_checks: `simplexml_load_string()`, `DOMDocument::loadXML()`, and `DOMDocument::load()` with tainted input and `LIBXML_NOENT`, or without `LIBXML_NONET`
